description:
Goal
Replace the remaining recursive transport-layout authority with one root-scoped runtime transport spine modeled after compiler2 Types. ShapeId is a small interned handle; each Shape descriptor contains only interned child ids, so interning goes all the way down. Shape = Nothing | Lane(LaneId) | Tuple(Vec<ShapeId>) | Callable(CallableId). The spine is built once after runtime demand settles. TransportPosition facts map executable inputs, returns, resumes, entry captures, body values, and continuation payload positions to ShapeId. ValueId is not part of shape identity. LaneId names one non-callable transported leaf; CallableId names callable identity; BoundaryId names one published callable contract. Downstream boundary, native, interpreter, and codegen details are fact-table columns keyed by ShapeId, LaneId, CallableId, BoundaryId, and the seam being emitted.

Required first step
fz-hwn.19.7 must happen before any other transport-spine or related symptom-ticket work: trash-prefix the doomed vocabulary so future agents cannot accidentally treat it as good architecture. RuntimeValueLayout, RuntimeInputLayout, the old RuntimeLane layout leaf, DeliveredShape, NativeDemandAbi, recursive value mirrors, and shape-translation helpers should become visibly marked garbage before implementation continues. No aliases, no bridges, no behavior changes in that guardrail commit.

Signal
No stage below spine construction walks one transport vocabulary to emit another. Tests assert interned spine facts and fact-table projections, not RuntimeValueLayout/DeliveredShape copies. The worked-example shape is representable: tuple-field return and resume share the same ShapeId; direct callable transport uses CallableId plus capture lane facts; escaped callable publication uses BoundaryId; codegen repr is a seam fact, not shape. Quicksort tuple-field transport, direct callable returns/resumes, ignored values, escaped callables, opaque callable boundaries, backend interpreter parity, and native JIT all remain correct.

Strategy
Work data-model-up. First trash-prefix the doomed vocabulary, then pin current contracts, then introduce the interned spine and fact tables, then switch one seam at a time by deleting the old recursive model from that seam in the same commit. No compatibility bridge is committed. RuntimeValueLayout, DeliveredShape, RealizedValue layout trees, local repr derivation, boundary-contract derivation by layout walk, and shape-recovery helpers are removal targets, not extension points.

Design rule
The only runtime shape authority after demand settles is the transport spine. Divergence is is_empty(return_ty), not a shape. ExecutableNeed stays the coarse pre-spine seed. RuntimeDemand::Ignore becomes Shape::Nothing exactly once during spine construction. CallableId is callable identity; BoundaryId is published callable contract identity. Boundary and codegen representations are contextual facts, not LaneId or Shape variants.
title: Compiler2 transport spine: replace runtime layout translations with one interned transport authority
